investigation_summary: Extensive search of reachable and dangling git objects (1,695 objects), git reflog, and local temporary paths confirmed that benchmark_manifest.json was modified in place when test_g3_a_benchmark_alignment_and_dimensions invoked build_and_export_p3_benchmark with production data_dir. Because benchmark_manifest.json is excluded from Git tracking via .gitignore, the byte-for-byte original file with generated_at_utc timestamp matching 7f76f918... was overwritten on disk.

canonical_semantic_verification.reason_for_hash_difference: The JSON payload differs only in the metadata timestamp 'generated_at_utc' written by datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(). All semantic data arrays, coverage metrics, and input/output hashes are identical.

protective_measures.isolation_method: All benchmark build calls now execute in pytest tmp_path fixtures with symlinked raw data.
